**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The warranty package in Section 9(b) meets and in places exceeds our preferred position:

- **Performance warranty present**: Service will "perform in all material respects to industry standards" (p0034) and services will be "free from errors that materially affect their utility" (p0038) — the functional equivalent of professional/workmanlike plus conformance.
- **Duration better than preferred**: these are continuing warranties/covenants for the entire Term, not a 12-month or 90-day window.
- **Compliance with laws** (p0041) and **no malicious code** (p0036) are both expressly covered.
- **Disclaimer does not swallow the warranty**: Section 13 is double-qualified ("Except as expressly set forth herein" / "except for the representations and warranties set forth in this Agreement"), so it reaches only implied warranties and the revenue/profit guarantee — nowhere near walk-away "AS IS".

Noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged: there is no express repair/re-perform/refund remedy sentence. That is a sub-element short of the preferred wording, and its absence favours us — we retain full direct-damages recovery and the 30-day cure/termination right under 4(b) instead of being confined to an exclusive, capped remedy. Inserting the model remedy language would risk narrowing our position, so I left it alone.
